label: pr0.3
method: Back-to-back A/B in ONE machine session: pr0.2 src+app checked out, built and measured, then the branch restored, rebuilt and measured minutes later. 5 mobile Lighthouse runs per surface per side. This supersedes every earlier capture, which compared against a baseline taken on a different day -- on this host the SAME pr0.2 code measured 325ms home TBT one day and 154ms the next, so cross-session deltas measured the machine, not the code.
attribution_caveat: READ BEFORE CITING ANY NUMBER IN THIS FILE. Both commit fields were written with the same sha, so this artifact cannot attest which code produced the baseline column: the pr0.2 tree was checked out OVER the working tree and its sha was never captured. The branch column is 3cdc17db, TWO commits behind the branch head -- it predates a164a48 (dead sort-control fix + bento cqw @supports fallback) and 35cb789. Neither column measures the code actually being shipped. Corrected 2026-07-29 by recording the defect rather than re-measuring: CI Lighthouse on PR #160 is authoritative for anything load-bearing, and it independently corroborates the event CLS claim on separate hardware (0.182 -> 0.038). The calendar CLS figure below has no CI equivalent -- the Lighthouse job measures homepage, landing and event only -- so treat it as indicative, not proven.
baseline_commit: UNRECORDED -- pr0.2 src+app checked out over the tree; sha never captured
